newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hyundai Elec targets 4.1 trln won sales.
newsitem.headline: Hyundai Elec targets 4.1 trln won sales.

text.p: South Korean chipmaker Hyundai Electronics Industries Co Ltd said on Friday it had set the target for this year's sales at 4.1 trillion won, up from an estimated 3.2 trillion won sales in 1996.
A company spokesman said sales in 1996 were far lower than its original target of 6.72 trillion won set early last year due to plunges in international prices of memory chips.
"Like other chipmakers, there was a big difference between the original target and actual sales last year due to weak chip prices," said Hyundai spokesman Lee Yong-il.
The company is a unit of South Korea's largest conglomerate
The company plans to invest two trillion won this year in research and development projects and facility expansion, compared with an 2.4 trillion won investment in 1996, he said.
